caption:
does sugar cause acne?

In a 12-week trial, 43 young men with acne were split into two groups. One switched to a low glycemic load diet, with more protein and slower carbs.

Their spot counts dropped by 23.5 on average, versus 12 in the group on a regular diet. They also lost weight, so it's hard to say which change helped.

It's one small trial in young men, but it's a hint worth knowing.

Send this to the friend who lives on candy.

General education only. Not medical advice.

Source:
Smith et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2007. doi:10.1093/ajcn/86.1.107
